source.title: Risk-averse Contextual Multi-armed Bandit Problem with Linear Payoffs

claims.statement: For disjoint arms under a Gaussian likelihood, update normal-gamma A, b, C and D posterior parameters after observed rewards.
claims.implementation: RiskAverseBandit._update implements the scalar d=1 specialization; train and decide call it

claims.statement: Sample an arm's precision and mean, then maximize sampled contextual mean minus risk tolerance times sampled variance.
The contextual bandit learns from rewards of selected arms over successive rounds.
claims.implementation: RiskAverseBandit.decide updates the held arm's posterior from the next observed mid-price interval

chosen_variant: One-dimensional queue-imbalance context, three disjoint target-position arms and online normal-gamma updates
adaptations: The paper's portfolio-selection experiment has multidimensional arm-specific contexts and rewards; this runtime example uses one L1 imbalance context shared across three unit-position arms and synthetic rewards.

A decision fills on the next tick. Online reward is computed from the mid-price change over an interval in which the arm was actually held; it omits execution fees, financing, opportunity cost and a portfolio reward model.
The implementation uses the paper's exact scalar normal-gamma posterior update and sampled mean-variance criterion, but does not reproduce its regret bound or empirical portfolio results.
